title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Guidance — Courtesy Waivers of Late Fees and Late Payment Charges
content:
A correctly charged late fee or late payment charge on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account may be waived in full as a courtesy at the request of an owner, principal or authorized buyer. Returned payment fees, bank card surcharges and discount recaptures are never waived as a courtesy.

## Conditions, all read from the account's records

| Condition | Rule |
|---|---|
| Account status | The account status must be active at the time of the request. |
| Request window | The waiver must be requested no more than the tier's request window, in calendar days, after the charge was posted. Days are counted as calendar days from the charge's posting date as day 0 to the date of the request, and a request on the last day still qualifies. |
| Waivers already used | The number of courtesy waivers on the account in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of the request must be below the tier's courtesy waiver count. |
| Size of the charge | A charge larger than the tier's largest waivable charge is not waivable in whole or in part. |
| Not already waived or reversed | A charge that already has a courtesy waiver or a fee reversal referencing it cannot be waived. |
| Correction owed | When the charge is owed a correction, the correction applies instead and no courtesy waiver is used. |

A waiver, when granted, is the full charge.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 30 Select: 2 waivers, 250.00, 60 days)

- Charge posted 1 August, request on 30 September: day 60, within the window. Request on 1 October: day 61, outside it.
- One waiver in the rolling 12 months: 1 is below 2, the count condition holds. Two waivers: 2 is not below 2, it does not.
- A late payment charge of 250.00 is waivable on size; one of 250.01 is not waivable at all, not even down to 250.00.
- An account on hold at the time of the request: the status condition is not met.
